description: This file defines the WorkflowStateMachineDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the WorkflowStateMachine entity. It provides methods to access the wrapped WorkflowStateMachine object and retrieve roles to notify, formatted as an array.

classes.name: WorkflowStateMachineDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional or simplified access to a WorkflowStateMachine entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a WorkflowStateMachine object.

methods.name: getRolesToNotify
methods.description: Retrieves roles to notify from the wrapped WorkflowStateMachine, returning them as an array or null.
